national_news.title: 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting Held in New Delhi
bullets: Union Minister Bhupender Yadav presided over the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
The theme for India's BRICS Chairship is 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
India reduced its pollution emission intensity by over 37 percent between 2005 and 2022, with clean sources accounting for over half of its total power capacity.

national_news.title: Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth Conferred Honorary Rank of General of Nepali Army
bullets: Indian Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth was conferred the honorary rank of General of the Nepal Army by President Ramchandra Paudel in Kathmandu.
The tradition of conferring honorary general ranks to each other's army chiefs by India and Nepal began in 1950.
The visit aimed to strengthen bilateral military relations and comprehensive ties between New Delhi and Kathmandu.

national_news.title: BWF Badminton World Championships: Ayush Shetty Stuns World No. 1 Shi Yu Qi
bullets: India's Ayush Shetty defeated world number one and defending champion Shi Yu Qi of China in the first round of men's singles at the BWF Badminton World Championships in New Delhi.
Ace shuttler PV Sindhu advanced to the second round with a dominant win over Ireland's Sophia Noble.
Indian women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand also progressed to the next round.

national_news.title: 5th Edition of SEMICON India 2026 to be Held in New Delhi
bullets: The 5th edition of SEMICON India 2026 will be held in New Delhi, inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The theme for the conference is 'Silicon to Systems, Building the Ecosystems'.
The event features participation from over 500 exhibitors across 40 countries, highlighting India's growing semiconductor ecosystem.

national_news.title: Defence Ministry Notifies Sixth Positive Indigenisation List with 405 Items
bullets: The Ministry of Defence notified the sixth Positive Indigenisation List (PIL) comprising 405 strategically important items.
The list includes 16 items for the Indian Coast Guard and 389 items for Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs).
Items include Line Replaceable Units, sub-systems, sub-assemblies, spares, and raw materials to promote self-reliance under Aatmanirbhar Bharat.

national_news.title: Indian Army Contingent Departs for India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV
bullets: The 15th edition of India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV (2026) is scheduled from 18 to 31 August 2026 at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp, Surat Thani, Thailand.

The contingents comprise 85 personnel from each side, with the Indian Army primarily represented by the 9 Gorkha Rifles and the Royal Thai Army by the 3rd Battalion, 25th Infantry Brigade, 5th Division.
The exercise focuses on company-level joint training for counter-insurgency and terrorist operations in jungle and semi-urban terrains under Chapter VII of the United Nations Charter.

national_news.title: UDISE+ 2025–26 Report Highlights Progress in School Education and NEP Implementation
bullets: The Unified District Information System for Education Plus (UDISE+) 2025–26 report covers 14.67 lakh schools, 1.03 crore teachers, and 24.72 crore students across India.
The overall Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) stands at a favourable 24:1, which is comfortably within the NEP 2020 recommended benchmark of 30:1.
The Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) at the Secondary stage improved to 71.7%, while the Middle stage GER stood at 89.6%.

national_news.title: India Signs Rs 1,943 Crore Deal to Lease Two MQ-9B Sea Guardian Drones for Indian Navy
bullets: The Ministry of Defence signed a contract with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc (GA-ASI) to lease two MQ-9B Sea Guardian High-Altitude Long-Endurance (HALE) RPAS for 30 months.
The deal is valued at approximately Rs 1,943 crore and was formalized in New Delhi on August 17, 2026.

The drones are equipped with advanced sensors and payloads to significantly enhance the Indian Navy's Maritime Domain Awareness and persistent Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance capabilities over the Indian Ocean Region.

national_news.title: Security Agencies Dismantle ISI-Backed Shahzad Bhatti Network Across 14 States
bullets: Security agencies conducted a multi-state crackdown on August 12, 2026, busting the ISI-backed Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN).
A total of 253 people were detained across 14 states, with over 80 FIRs and 200+ arrests recorded under UAPA, BNS, Arms Act, and Explosive Substances Act.
Recoveries included IEDs, Pakistan Ordnance Factory marked grenades, pistols, live cartridges, and espionage CCTV cameras.

national_news.title: Department of Financial Services Hosts PSB Confluence 2026
bullets: The Department of Financial Services (DFS) organized the two-day PSB Confluence 2026 focusing on Deposit Mobilisation, Banking for Youth, Investment Cycle, and GCCs.
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced that a high-powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat will be formed soon.
The Finance Minister highlighted that India's youth (aged 15-29 years, making up 29% of the population) are a critical focus area for future banking.

national_news.title: India Ranks as World's Largest Producer of Areca Nut in 2025-26
bullets: According to the Directorate of Arecanut and Spices Development (DASD), India accounts for about 63% of total global areca nut production in 2025-26.
The total area under arecanut cultivation increased to 11.06 lakh hectares with an estimated production of 15.29 lakh tonnes.
Karnataka is the largest producer in India, yielding about 10 lakh tonnes, followed by Kerala, Assam, and other states.

national_news.title: Centre Approves Detailed Estimate for Qadian-Beas Railway Line in Punjab
bullets: The Centre approved a detailed estimate of ₹1,419.05 crore for the 39.68 km Qadian-Beas broad gauge railway line in Punjab's Majha region.
The project includes two crossing stations (Ghuman and Butala), 11 major bridges, 121 minor bridges, and 54 Road Under Bridges (RUBs).
The infrastructure project incorporates indigenous train collision avoidance system 'Kavach' and is executed by Northern Railway.

national_news.title: Analysis of EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and India-EU Trade Pact
bullets: The EU and India concluded Free Trade Agreement (FTA) negotiations in January 2026, coinciding with the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) entering its definitive financial phase.
Experts warn that differing carbon cost measurement frameworks risk imposing a double compliance burden on Indian exporters.
Harmonising domestic emissions regulations with the EU's CBAM is critical to preserving trade liberalisation gains under the India-EU partnership.

bihar_news.title: Smallholder Farmers and Carbon Credit Programmes in India
bullets: India accounts for around 4.1 percent of the global voluntary carbon market, with smallholder farmers making up over 80 percent of the farming population.
A study involving smallholder farmers in Bihar examined participation barriers in voluntary carbon credit programmes.
Upfront financial support, training, and technical assistance emerged as key preferences for smallholders to adopt climate-friendly farming practices.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Joins Centre's Direct Pulse Procurement Network
bullets: For the first time, Bihar joined the Centre's direct pulse procurement network, allowing central agencies to buy masoor directly from farmers.
Central agencies like NCCF and Nafed procured around 3,000 tonnes of masoor against a target of 32,000 tonnes at an MSP of ₹7,000 per quintal.
Bihar produces nearly 400,000 tonnes of pulses annually across 448,000 hectares under pulse cultivation.

bihar_news.title: Darbhanga Ranks Second in Bihar in Sugarcane IDs
bullets: Darbhanga emerged as Bihar's second-highest district in obtaining Sugarcane IDs, with 24,215 farmers joining the expansion campaign.
West Champaran holds the first rank in the state for the number of Sugarcane IDs issued.
The Sugarcane ID connects farmers with government schemes, technical support, and cultivation-related incentives.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Operations from October 15, Announces CM Samrat Choudhary
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the auction of critical and strategic mineral blocks and the NMEDT workshop organized by the Ministry of Coal and Mines in Patna.
The state government announced that over 30 out of 44 surveyed coal and mineral blocks will be allocated before September 30, with active tenders underway for 28 blocks.
Mining operations in Bihar are officially scheduled to resume starting October 15, utilizing mineral wealth from districts like Rohtas, Aurangabad, Jamui, and Gaya for state welfare.

bihar_news.title: Key Infrastructure and Welfare Announcements by Bihar Government
bullets: Road and water infrastructure for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) will be completed before 2027, with water supply planned from the Sone river to the Falgu river.
A World Trade Center is set to be constructed in Patna to boost trade, industry, and economic activities.
The 'Vidyarthi Sahyog Portal' has been launched to resolve student grievances and bring transparency to the education system.
